caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick holder centered on a plain, beige background. The candlestick holder features a wide, rounded base that is shaded predominantly in greenish-grey with white highlights to indicate shine. The stem of the holder is ornate and consists of multiple segments, including a central twisted section with alternating red and white diagonal stripes, flanked by rounded and bulbous elements that are also shaded in greenish-grey. The holder has a broad, flat rim at the top, supporting a short cylindrical cup intended to hold a candle, which is also colored in the same greenish-grey tones. Above the cup, a faint outline of a white candle with a wick is visible, but there is no visible flame. The overall composition is upright, with the candlestick standing vertically in the center of the image, and there is a small artist’s signature in red at the bottom right corner. There are also a few faint brown marks or blemishes in the upper left quadrant of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
